headline: Chinese Sponsors Drop Kylian Mbappé Over Mao Zedong Meme Controversy
summary: Major Chinese brands have dropped French soccer star Kylian Mbappé following a backlash over a video clip in which he allegedly commented on a meme depicting him as Chinese dictator Mao Zedong.
why: Endorsement contracts rely heavily on player reputation, and political sensitivities in international markets can prompt rapid termination of corporate sponsorships.

impacts.name: Sports Marketing and Endorsements
impacts.why: Controversial public remarks lead Chinese corporate sponsors to sever commercial endorsement ties.
